# ONAP supplemental egress allow-list.
#
# Consumed via lfreleng-actions/harden-runner-block-action, which
# merges this file with the lfreleng-actions baseline when a workflow
# passes 'supplemental_config: onap@main'. Entries here reach ONAP
# workflows only, so this is the place for endpoints that ONAP
# infrastructure needs and other LF projects do not. Endpoints shared
# across projects belong in the baseline:
#
#   https://github.com/lfreleng-actions/.github/blob/main/.github/harden-runner/lfreleng-actions/allow_list.txt
#
# Same format as the baseline: one host[:port] entry per line, sorted
# alphabetically (LC_ALL=C), with a '# comment' above any entry whose
# purpose is not obvious. A '*.host' entry matches exactly ONE label.
# The merge de-duplicates, so an entry may appear in both files while
# it migrates from one to the other.

# Sphinx redoc extension (sphinxcontrib-redoc); policy/parent sets
# redoc_uri to the bundle at https://cdn.redoc.ly/redoc/latest/, which
# the extension downloads when the build finishes. Blocking it failed
# every policy/parent documentation build.
cdn.redoc.ly:443

# Container registry (Nordix); ONAP integration tests pull
# onaptest/postgres from here via Testcontainers. It sits outside
# docker.pull.registry, so the Nexus3 entries do not cover it.
registry.nordix.org:443
